messages.subject: General Shinyapp server query
parts:
Hi,

Does Shinyapp servers have CDN feature to allow better user experience?  Also, does it use some sort of reverse proxy server provision like nginx etc.

Thank you
SD

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] General Shinyapp server query
parts:
We do not offer any CDN services with shinyapps.io. That does not preclude you from using your own CDN, if you are comfortable with setting it up and managing it.

As for reverse proxying, shinyapps.io does use proxying, and allows an application be backed by multiple instances if you are in a paid plan. I'm not sure why you would want your own reverse proxy in front of shinyapps.io.
